newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ First's Peters now Treasurer, tax cuts deferred.
newsitem.headline: NZ First's Peters now Treasurer, tax cuts deferred.

text.p: New Zealand First Party leader Winston Peters said on Tuesday he would take on a new role as Treasurer in a new coalition government with the caretaker National Party.
He said National would decide who was Finance Minister, and Prime Minister Jim Bolger later said current Finance Minister Bill Birch would work with Peters.

Peters said the next round of income tax cuts, which have been passed into legislation and were due to take effect on July 1, 1997, would be deferred until July 1, 1998. They would be subject to continuing adequate surpluses.
NZ First's plan to channel the tax cut money into a compulsory superannuation scheme would be subject to a referendum, Peters said.
